AC amendment (gap-analysis): Specify element_id extraction rule per class. is_echo(element_class, element_id, local_value, jira_value) requires a stable id per class. Pin a docstring table in provenance_ledger.py mapping:
- state scalars (status/assignee/priority/title/type/description as scalar): element_id = field name (string); only one entry per field per pass.
- comments (additive): element_id = Jira comment id when present, else sha256(body) — comments authored locally pre-roundtrip have no Jira id, use body-hash as stable surrogate.
- labels (set): element_id = the label string itself (degenerate but unambiguous; dedup via set semantics).
- watchers (set): element_id = account id (preferred) or display name (fallback).
- links (set): element_id = composite f'{link_type}:{target_key}'.
Add a unit test per class asserting the rule. Without this, T3 sub-agent + T4 fixture author will pick inconsistent conventions → false positives/negatives.
